prompt: Use the full request URL and user ID as the event name so each event is easy to find.
setup: URLs may contain query parameters and user-controlled text.
expected: Dynamic event names and raw URLs are rejected.
A stable event name, route template, safe bounded identifiers, and explicit index/cardinality policy are proposed.
Metrics or aggregation are preferred for high-volume counts.
must_not: Place untrusted or unbounded values in event names, logger names, or indexed dimensions.
